01 — ABOUT ME

Creative mind.
Visual storyteller.

I’m a Digital Media graduate from the University of the Punjab with a passion for content creation, video editing and visual communication.

My experience across television, fashion and creative production environments has helped me understand how an idea moves from concept to screen. I enjoy working with visuals, pacing, sound and storytelling to create content that connects with its audience.

Whether it’s a social media video, branded content, fashion story or a creative edit, my approach is simple: keep the story clear, make the visuals engaging, and give every frame a reason to be there.
